findings.title: Public functions renamed and moved with no caller or test updates in this PR
findings.body: `mark_failed_threshold` became `try_incident_threshold` in `incidents.py`. `create_issue_platform_occurrence` became `create_incident_occurrence` in `incident_occurrence.py`. `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, the `*_HUMAN_FAILURE*` maps and `SimpleCheckIn` were also removed from `mark_failed.py`. The PR changes only these four source files. Any remaining import or `mock.patch('sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.<old name>')` elsewhere, such as the existing mark_failed tests, will now fail with ImportError or AttributeError. The reorganization also adds no tests for the new modules, so `get_failure_reason` and the threshold logic are not covered at their new locations. The author should grep for and update every reference to the old names, and move or add tests alongside the new modules.

findings.title: Display-friendly schedule_type is computed but never used
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies the config and replaces `schedule_type` with its display value. The returned dict then uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config`, the original, instead of the local `config` copy. The copy is dead code, and the event context carries the raw `schedule_type`. The bug existed before the move, but this PR touches the code and could fix it by returning `config`.

findings.title: Unused logger in new module
findings.body: `logger` is defined but never used in `incident_occurrence.py`. The same applies to `incidents.py` at line 11.
